finish.summary:
Single attempt, no reset. Task: "pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy". Localized everything with agentview_high + back_project (caddy rim z~1.06, table 0.90; book at (-0.36,-0.06); target pocket ~(-0.39,-0.14) per the s0/t5-family memory = the caddy's shallow CENTER-FRONT near pocket). The first pi0_pick of the black book succeeded and the scripted carry reached the pocket, but I RELEASED at eef z=1.084 with the book center at (-0.355,-0.115,1.03) — ~3.5 cm too shallow in x and 2.5 cm short in y, so the In predicate did not fire; the book flopped out and ended standing on edge against the caddy's front wall.

That pose proved unrecoverable within this one episode: the book is ~8 x 9 x 3 cm, so its width equals the 8 cm jaw maximum and it can only be gripped across its 3 cm thickness. Every subsequent top-down pinch closed on air, four pi0_pick attempts and a 30-chunk pi0_doubled closed on air, and scripted reaches jammed (final_dist 0.14). Root cause of the jams: Pi0's failed re-pick left the wrist rolled ~108-148 deg about -x, and the runtime's pitch tool is roll-agnostic — rotate_pitch(target=0) is a no-op, delta_pitch rotates about a tool-local axis (108->146->205->301 deg), rotate_wrist/ move_pose made it worse (eef diverged to x=-0.60), so the vertical grasp pose could never be restored.

Max progress: eef (-0.4526,-0.0993,1.207); book never seated in the pocket. terminated:false; audit + recipe written.

## Winning technique
1. Pre-position eef directly above the mug: `move_to (mug_x, mug_y, ~1.06) gripper -1`.

   or released) — no release needed once libero_terminated flips.
